Incorrect. The article does not mention him as a king of Larsa; he conquered Larsa.

Through oral traditions passed down by his descendants
Through inscriptions on the pyramids of Egypt

questions.question: What does the most common translation of the name Hammurabi mean?

questions.question: Why was it common for Amorite chieftains to have names referring to ancestors?
options: Because connection to lineage was essential for legitimacy
Because they were required by law

Because they had no other names

questions.question: How was Hammurabi viewed after his death?
